description: Third parties recruited into the couple's tension as allies and judges.
transcript:
A: My mother agrees with me about this. I told her the whole thing on Sunday.
B: You talked to your mother about our marriage before you talked to me?
A: Everyone thinks the same. Ask your sister if you don't believe me.
B: So now your family is the jury.
A: Even the kids can see how you get. They said so.
B: Leave them out of it. This is between us.
A: My mother says you have always been like this.
B: I am not going to argue with people who are not in the room.

gold.notes: 'I am not going to argue with people who are not in the room' is a refusal under 60-behavioral.
